question: What is the average monthly income per agricultural household in India, according to the 77th round of National Statistical Office (NSO) survey, calculated using the paid-out expenses approach?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**₹ 10,218**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **77th Round of the National Statistical Office (NSO) Survey** provides critical data on the socio-economic conditions of **agricultural households in India**.
 
• According to this survey, the **average monthly income** per agricultural household in India, calculated using the **paid-out expenses approach**, is **₹ 10,218**.
 
• This figure includes income from various sources such as:
 
 
• **Wages and salaries**
 
• **Crop production**
 
• **Livestock** and allied activities
 
• **Non-farm business activities**
 
• Other forms of income like **leasing out land** or **remittances**.
 
 
 
• The survey highlights that **agricultural households** in India face **incomes disparities**, with significant variations across states, regions, and landholding sizes.
 
• The data is instrumental for policymakers to design **welfare programs** and schemes aimed at improving the **livelihoods** of farmers.
 
• It also provides insights into the **economic viability** of farming as a profession in modern India.
 
• The approach used in this survey is the **paid-out expenses approach**, which accounts for the cost incurred by farmers on inputs like **fertilizers, seeds, labor, and other resources**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Importance of the NSO Survey**__

 __
 
• The **NSO survey** is a key tool used by the government to assess the **economic conditions of households**, particularly those engaged in **agriculture**.
 
• Data from the survey is used to gauge **farmers’ income levels**, helping to inform and assess the effectiveness of schemes like **PM-KISAN**, **Kisan Credit Card**, and **crop insurance programs**.
 
• The survey also identifies **areas of improvement** in agricultural policy, such as access to credit, market linkages, and input subsidies.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Highlighted**__
 __
 
• The data underscores the **low earnings** from agriculture, with many farmers relying on **non-agricultural sources** for additional income.
 
• It points to the **need for diversification** of income sources and improved **pricing mechanisms** for agricultural produce.
 
• The survey also reflects issues such as **lack of access to modern technology, irrigation facilities**, and **market infrastructure**.
 
 
 
• **Other Options**__
 
 
• The other options such as ₹ 6,426, ₹ 8,000, and ₹ 12,000 do not reflect the accurate data as per the **77th NSO Survey**.
 
• These figures might represent income levels in specific states or regions but are not the **national average**.
